title: Prove cyclic single-port query networks preserve the pair-reader floor
body:
## Summary

Prove marked source/reader support transfer for arbitrary finite two-terminal graphic substitutions of an unmarked query. Internal directions can be shared by cyclic edges. The non-Fano literal pair floor remains `m_A+m_B`, with no term-count or augmented-rank bound.

```text
edge differences in one query port
  exact terminal-recovery predicate
    terminal connectivity over every field
      same marked source/reader implications
```

The Wheatstone predicate has no read-once AND/OR formula, so this closes a changed cyclic-sharing hypothesis beyond PR3524's operation history. [Written proof and boundaries](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/91f9cae78a9e725202494f62065b53a44306ce27/research/p112-graphic-query-transfer/PROOF.md). Only 12 new files under `research/p112-graphic-query-transfer` change. Predecessor bytes and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3524 covers read-once series/parallel query rewrites and excludes arbitrary shared internal directions.
  **After:** the rank-one interface lemma and graph path/cut proof cover every finite two-terminal network. Two separate programs agree on 1,098 graph subsets and 15 bridge-expanded placements, checking 3,440 source and 7,760 reader premises.
- A literal nine-term operator has actual ranks `(5,5)`, exact endpoint `diag(1,0,1,0,0,0)` and rectangular charges `[2,4,2,0,2,0,2,2,2]`, total 16 versus floor 4. This is a losing control, not a minimum or saving.
- Four mutations reject in eight optimized real-CLI runs, with four positive runs and unchanged canonical hashes. CPython 3.12 direct, registered, metadata/pin, focused Ruff and format checks pass. Final committed source-history and official export integrity gates pass; the committed scientific/control commands also pass from a Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`.

```sh
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p112-graphic-query-transfer/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p112-graphic-query-transfer/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p112-graphic-query-transfer/test_controls.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-graphic-query-transfer
python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-graphic-query-transfer --check-source-history
```

Exact source origins, blobs and SHA256, including inherited mathematical proof premises, are retained and exported. Credit stays with Philippe Van Velzen, ctoth and the actual-reader lineage through PR3506/PR3513/PR3524. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19011221).

Cross-port internal sharing and field-sensitive interfaces remain open. Acquisition, dirty restoration, frames, hosting, precision, stock, compiler/all-size and complete consumers are unproved here. No cheaper decoder, physical supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

An isolated research package with opt-in verification and pinned inherited inputs.

**Blast Radius:** research
